title: Figure 35: ANSYS acoustic mesh plot, 1000 Hz with 50 elements per wavelength in water
description: ANSYS 12.1 mesh plot of the quarter-circle acoustic domain labeled 'Uniformly Radiating Sphere, EPW=50,' captioned 'Mesh Plot for 1,000 Hz with 50 Elements per Wavelength in Water.' Finer mesh refinement case for the BAASS underwater sound propagation convergence study.
